name: Transparency Data Report 20
definition: Provides for reporting calculation results of non equity instruments as part of transparency.

TechnicalRecordIdentification.name: Technical Record Identification
TechnicalRecordIdentification.definition: Unique identifier of a record in a message used as part of error management and status advice messages.||Usage:|This identification will be used in the status advice report sent back.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identifies the financial instrument or the class of financial instruments to which the result relates.

FullName.name: Full Name
FullName.definition: Full name of the reporting entity.

TradingVenue.name: Trading Venue
TradingVenue.definition: Segment MIC for the trading venue where applicable, otherwise the operational MIC.

ReportingPeriod.name: Reporting Period
ReportingPeriod.definition: Period to which the quantitative data fields relate.

Liquidity.name: Liquidity
Liquidity.definition: Flag to say if this ISIN is liquid or not post calculations.||Usage:|When not present, this field should be treated as not applicable.

PreTradeLargeInScaleThreshold.name: Pre Trade Large In Scale Threshold
PreTradeLargeInScaleThreshold.definition: The pre-trade Large in Scale threshold.

PostTradeLargeInScaleThreshold.name: Post Trade Large In Scale Threshold
PostTradeLargeInScaleThreshold.definition: The post-trade Large in Scale threshold.

PreTradeInstrumentSizeSpecificThreshold.name: Pre Trade Instrument Size Specific Threshold
PreTradeInstrumentSizeSpecificThreshold.definition: The pre-trade Size Specific to an Instrument threshold.

PostTradeInstrumentSizeSpecificThreshold.name: Post Trade Instrument Size Specific Threshold
PostTradeInstrumentSizeSpecificThreshold.definition: The post-trade Size Specific to an Instrument threshold.

Statistics.name: Statistics
Statistics.definition: Statistics for a financial instrument generated as part of transparency calculations.

ValidISINRule.definition: ISIN code must pass checksum validation.

ValidMICRule.definition: Where reported, market Identification code must be an active market for that reporting period.
